bootstrap_steps.operation: Create P2 scaffold/testing and fail-closed platform gate, then actual platform schemas/fixtures and dated Action mapping. Consume P1.4 package map; new namespace child prefixes have one owner; preserve current SDK and frozen 2026-08. All names here remain planned until owning tasks create them.
bootstrap_steps.verification: Verify schema/fixture positive and negative controls, exact suite registry and missing-suite/zero-test/required-skip nonzero behavior; core source and production dependency checks must inspect real source, not absent directories.

bootstrap_steps.operation: Create new AgenTools SQL schema and migration/version record using P3.1 install path in a proven isolated PostgreSQL database. Create required package manifests/config/locks before their suites. Reuse existing dated SDK stores through their interfaces; no Botkit database/backup/reader required.
bootstrap_steps.verification: Before any mutation verify database name, owner and explicit isolated-test allow marker; refuse development/production DSNs. Assert tenant composite keys/FKs, id/hash conflict, version/CAS and clean install. Required real PostgreSQL missing is failure, not mock substitution.

bootstrap_steps.operation: Register code-only ActionDefinition implementations and trusted host ports. Resolve versioned configuration/bundle/registry hashes and credential refs; the initial minimal code configuration supports the first vertical without requiring optional admin/scheduler or the later profile publisher. DB settings never load classes, SQL, arbitrary URLs or grant tools.
bootstrap_steps.verification: Reject missing/mismatched registry/hash/config versions and production InMemory/Fake persistence. Keep core construction free of PDO/network/framework; testing profile is explicit and retains tenant/purpose/tool/confirmation/disclosure guards.
bootstrap_steps.owner: P3.1 initial code registry/config; Profiles publisher P7.1

bootstrap_steps.operation: Create new tenant-bound AssistantSession/Turn/Run from trusted context, accepted source-event identity and payload hash. Bind immutable configuration/bundle and model/deployment versions; persist proposal, effect, delivery and usage mappings before their respective boundaries. No import of Botkit sessions/users.
bootstrap_steps.verification: Duplicate same tenant/key/hash replays saved identity/result; differing hash is integrity_conflict. Cross-tenant keys/FKs cannot link. Pins never grant current permissions: revoke/consent/emergency checks run immediately before disclosure/provider/owner IO; denied pins remain historical, never rewritten.

bootstrap_steps.operation: Build the first headless read journey with real kernel/stores/isolated PG, scripted transport/external owners and one guarded read Action. Persist intake/run, invocation result/proposal map, committed intent, response/delivery and nullable versioned usage. Exactly AgenTools Runtime owns the turn loop.
bootstrap_steps.verification: Crash/replay from persisted boundaries preserves Turn/Run/Action/effect/delivery identities; stale epochs fail CAS. No external IO under SQL lock. Outbox/scanner recovers after commit-before-enqueue; unknown differs from failed/success/zero. Scripted provider is not live qualification.

bootstrap_steps.operation: After the read vertical, add confirmation/write using existing ConfirmationService, token replay and fenced IdempotencyCoordinator. Reuse saved prepare result via durable proposal mapping; current owner authorization and committed intent/fence are required before effects.
bootstrap_steps.verification: Exercise denial/revoke/deadline/hash mismatch, duplicate confirmation, stale worker and owner-accepted/lost-reply. Do not reinterpret EffectCommitter local append as durable dispatcher proof. Unknown effect remains unresolved until owner lookup/manual outcome; no blind retry or compensating effect without separate authority.

bootstrap_steps.operation: Compose headless Laravel bindings/factories/scoped request/job context and managed entrypoint after read and confirmation/write. Public routes opt-in; raw is guarded or privileged internal transport-only without domain effects. Code plugins cannot bypass mandatory guards. Optional Filament inspector is read-only until P7.7 after P7.1 publisher; scheduler is optional.
bootstrap_steps.verification: Apply shared guard matrix to every exposed managed/raw/build/stream/background/voice/direct-actions path. Test sequential tenant A→B and recycled worker/Octane cleanup after success/exception/cancel; no actor/credential/policy/profile/cache/diagnostic leak. No second effect-capable loop.
bootstrap_steps.owner: P6.1-P6.3; optional P6.4/P6.5 and P7.7 later

bootstrap_steps.operation: Rehearse clean target install, read/write scripted journeys, crash/restart, isolated backup restore and projection rebuild on new-platform data. Consume current baseline and all owning runtime receipts; follow the recovery matrix and exact historical case aliases below. This ordered contract is not authorization to run later tasks.
bootstrap_steps.verification: Use real kernel + isolated PG with scripted external ports. Compare append-only Action event sequence/digest, projections/checkpoints, stable identities, outbox receipts and usage corrections after restore; current revocation and compatible bundle recovery still hold. No Botkit cutover or production switch; P13.2/P13.3/P13.4 own broader gates.
bootstrap_steps.owner: P13.1 (after its declared upstream P12.5); P13.2 regression / P13.3 packaging / P13.4 final acceptance

claims.statement: P1.4 records 13 grouped dispositions over the 41 P1.1 capabilities, a private additive package DAG, technical ownership and read-first order. This is a selected design, not implemented packages.

P1.4 ownership matrix assigns technical checkpoints/journal/outboxes to AgenTools and retains domain/history/rights/metering/admission/money authority outside it; no external implementation is qualified.
The recorded P1.3 compatibility contract is the downstream reference; this bootstrap adds no protocol status, SDK namespace/package change or new requirement for direct/offline consumers.
D7/M2: Botkit is donor-only. No Botkit data/users/backfill/shadow/cutover/facades are prerequisites; preserve actual AgenTools contracts and private owner release gates.
Ordered target bootstrap, schema/version ownership, stable identity and recovery obligations below are handoff requirements; their runtime checks remain planned.
No P2/P3 new platform runtime, isolated-PG recovery, no-dev packaging, remote host, live provider or pilot readiness is demonstrated by this design.

Inherited P1.1 source observation for agentools.fencing: Existing PostgreSQL idempotency store supplies fenced identity boundary; isolated database tests remain pending. Source/navigation evidence only; no new donor audit, executed test or active consumer claim.
